Name: Damage
Description: Deals X damage. SubType can split the hit across damage types: Fire 1, Cold 1 (a type and a weight for each part)

Name: Healing
Description: Heals X health

Name: Healing Over Time
Description: Heals X health every turn for Y turns

Name: Lifesteal
Description: Heals X health based on Y% of damage dealt

Name: Damage Over Time
Description: Deals X damage every turn for Y turns

Name: Cleanse
Description: Removes all debuffs from target

Name: Death Ward
Description: Revives target with X% health when they reach 0 health. Each death uses one of Y charges

Name: Shield
Description: Absorbs X attacks or Y turns

Name: Ward
Description: Applies X ward. A damage absorption pool shown under the health bar that cannot be dispelled

Name: Reflection
Description: Reflects X% of incoming damage for Y turns or Z charges. Goes off at the Armor step (after Armor), or at the Shield step with the full damage if it came with a Shield skill. Cond picks the damage it reflects: blank = every type, 'If fire damage' = one type or group, 'If fire, cold damage' = a combination

Name: Accuracy Boost
Description: Increases accuracy by X%. Accuracy cuts the target's effective armor

Name: Critical Chance Boost
Description: Increases critical chance by X%

Name: Critical Bonus Boost
Description: Adds X flat damage to the Critical Bonus of a critical hit (after the 2.0 multiplier). X is a plain number, not a percent

Name: Damage Boost
Description: Increases damage by X% of base damage. Stacks with the same effect from a skill with a different name; the same skill name keeps only the strongest

Name: Shield Break
Description: Deals X% bonus damage to enemies with wards active

Name: Armor Boost
Description: Increases armor effectiveness by X%

Name: Incoming Damage Reduction
Description: Reduces incoming damage by X%

Name: Critical Resistance
Description: Reduces the extra damage of incoming critical hits (the multiplier's extra and the flat Critical Bonus) by X%

Name: Resistance
Description: Moves the target up X resistance states for the specified damage type or group

Name: Health Boost
Description: Increases maximum health by X%. Current health rises by the same amount

Name: Reactive Healing
Description: Heals target for X health each time an attack does health damage to them, for Y turns or Z charges. Goes off before the death check, so it can save them. Damage over time does not trigger it

Name: Thorns
Description: Deals X damage to attackers when hit for Y turns or Z charges. Goes off on every hit (each hit of a multi-hit skill), but not on damage over time. Goes off at the Armor step, or at the Shield step if it came with a Shield skill

Name: Healing Received Boost
Description: Increases healing received by X%

Name: Healing Outgoing Boost
Description: Increases healing done by X%

Name: Attribute Boost
Description: Increases the specified attribute by X%

Name: Taunt
Description: Buff on the user. Forces enemy single-target attacks to target this character. Area attacks and skills that ignore taunt are not affected

Name: Provoke
Description: Forces target to use basic attacks against the caster

Name: Cooldown Reduction
Description: Reduces cooldowns by X

Name: Cooldown Increase
Description: Increases cooldowns by X, including skills that are ready. Basic attacks are exempt

Name: Accuracy Reduction
Description: Decreases accuracy by X%

Name: Critical Chance Reduction
Description: Decreases critical chance by X%

Name: Critical Bonus Reduction
Description: Takes X flat damage off the Critical Bonus (minimum 0). X is a plain number, not a percent

Name: Damage Output Reduction
Description: Decreases base skill damage by X%

Name: Armor Reduction
Description: Decreases armor by X%

Name: Damage Vulnerability
Description: Increases damage received by X%

Name: Weaken Critical Resistance
Description: Decreases critical resistance by X%

Name: Weaken Resistance
Description: Moves the target down X resistance states for the specified damage type or group

Name: Reduce Maximum Health
Description: Decreases maximum health by X%. Current health drops by the same amount (never below 1) and does not return when it ends

Name: Healing Received Reduction
Description: Reduces healing received by X%

Name: Healing Outgoing Reduction
Description: Reduces healing done by X%

Name: Attribute Reduction
Description: Decreases the specified attribute by X%

Name: Dispel
Description: Removes X buffs from target. Wards cannot be dispelled

Name: Steal Buff
Description: Removes a buff from target and transfers it to caster

Name: Ally Assist
Description: Causes a living ally to use their basic attack against target

Name: Ignore Taunt
Description: Allows the caster to use this skill against any target even if an enemy has taunt.

Name: Resurrection
Description: Resurrects an ally with x% health

Name: Summon
Description: Summons X,  a being to help the party for Y turns
